profile.headline: SWE Intern @ Google | 2x Prev @ Meta | CS @ UT Austin + Business Minor
profile.summary:
Hello! I am a current senior at The University of Texas at Austin, pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a minor in Business. Driven by a strong work ethic and a curiosity to explore all areas of computer science, I seek opportunities to learn, grow, and apply my skills to create meaningful impact. As well, from my experience as a small business owner, I've learned the value of face-to-face interaction, customer engagement, and effective communication.
Feel free to reach out at briannaflores867@utexas.edu!!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to the UT Registration Plus Chrome extension by collaborating with peers working within a large codebase, adding features to improve usability and streamline course registration for 60,000+ students at UT

positions.title: Small Business Owner
positions.description:
- Founded and scaled a successful business online, achieving 150+ e-commerce sales and 70+ five-star reviews
- Developed strong skills in customer service, management, digital marketing, organization, and finances as sole owner
- Participated in 20+ face-to-face vendor markets since April 2022, averaging $650+ in revenue per event, completed 35+ custom commissions from customers post-market, and was featured in the city’s official event recap
positions.insights: Skills: Small Business Development · Business Ownership · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Customer Service · Business Management · Web Development · Customer Satisfaction · Digital Marketing · Management · Financial Accounting

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Selected as 1 of 88 interns from 15,000+ applicants after competitive technical and behavioral interviews
- Completed a full-stack engineering bootcamp without prior experience
- Designed and executed a full-stack grocery list generator and recipe finder web app, leveraging React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS, PostgreSQL, pgAdmin, Prisma ORM, and integrating multiple APIs
- Designed a custom diffing algorithm to detect variations and leveraged Google Gemini API through prompt engineering to dynamically generate user-specific recipe substitutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · React · TypeScript · JavaScript · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · MUI · PostgreSQL · pgAdmin · Prisma ORM · Figma (Software) · GitHub · Git · Firebase · Google Gemini
